p.i: Prabes munifica multiplices manu. Et dum matribus ubera Dulci bina reples nectare providus: Infans quae simul ac novus Aspexit roseum purpurei iubar Solis quæritat impiger, Recludit que tuis lacteolos statim Fontes ductibus, ut premat, Dum fugit labiis ora rebellium.
INFESTUS primos qui perdidit ante parentes Serpens tergeminis me petit usque dolis:
Ut metus ex animo supremi Numinis, ebeu! Effluat & tuta religionis amor. Obiicit illecebras, fluxa ludibria vitae, Et mundi vanis fallit imaginibus.
Si qua adversa premunt, si rerum cogit egestas, Aude, ait: & quicquam turpe putare vetat.

page.notes: The first verse fragment is cut off at the top of the page and continues from page 96. The title line "DEGUMBERET" is read as DEGVMBERET; the fifth letter may be C, so it is marked [?]. The "G" at the lower right is a single letter with no following word; it is recorded as a catchword but may be a signature or printer's mark. The top word "Prabes" is printed with a swash P, read as Prabes. The bottom-left faint letters and the mirrored text on the right are show-through and are left out.
